newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY'S SESSION MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY'S SESSION MIXED.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against the U.S. unit and South Africa's rand but closed Monday's interbank session firmer on European currencies, foreign exchange dealers said.

"The market was a bit short to start with and there were a number of small payments which, put together, amounted to quite a bit. The (local) dollar lost three-quarters of a cent (against the key U.S. dollar) from where it was in the morning," commented one dealer.

"We are expecting a U.S.$10 million payment in the next couple of days, so depending on whether the (central) Reserve Bank pumps in some money or not, we could see our dollar depreciate further," he added.

At Monday's close, the local unit was indicated at 10.9050/9200 against the U.S. dollar, compared with 10.8950/9100 at the same time on Friday and also lost ground versus the rand to 2.3780/3830 from 2.3580/3640.
It however registered gains on European currencies, finishing firmer at 17.6800/7180 on sterling from 17.7315/7765 and at 6.6560/6700 from 6.6900/7025 against the mark.
